task_decomposition: Model 1 extracts the frozen evidence counts, stages, variants, profiles, and pass/fail results without adding unstated interpretations.
Model 2 classifies each candidate claim C1-C6 as supported, unsupported, or forbidden using only the provided allowed and forbidden claim boundaries.

Model 3 reviews Model 1 and Model 2 outputs for disagreements, especially around total run counts, Stage D-real scope, and whether Stage F/F concerns inter-model evidence checking rather than deployment validation.

Model 4 acts as final verifier and resolves disagreements conservatively: accept only claims directly grounded in the frozen evidence or allowed-claim list, reject claims matching forbidden categories, and mark ambiguous claims as not established.
success_criteria: C1 is accepted only as a count statement matching the frozen pre-extension evidence: 156 local artifact runs before the Stage E/F model-assisted extension.
C2 is accepted only if limited to Stage D-real having 120 executions over three implemented variants: full-l4, oracle-only, and no-ipfs.
C3 is rejected because production O-RAN deployment validation is forbidden and not evidenced.
C4 is rejected because a 240-run six-variant ablation is forbidden and not evidenced.
C5 is accepted if phrased as inter-model claim-boundary checking or disagreement resolution around local evidence, not as external deployment validation.
C6 is rejected because packet-capture network-impairment benchmark claims are forbidden and not evidenced.
parsed.candidate_safe_claim: The artifact supports local evidence-grounded orchestration claims, including 156 frozen local n8n evidence runs before the Stage E/F extension and 120 passed Stage D-real executions across three implemented variants.
candidate_risky_claims_to_check: The evidence proves production O-RAN deployment readiness.
The artifact includes a 240-run six-variant ablation study.
The results constitute a packet-capture network-impairment benchmark.
Stage F/F demonstrates more than inter-model claim-boundary checking around the local artifact.
Stage D-real validates public-chain or media-plane QoE behavior.
parsed.next_agent_instruction: Classify C1-C6 using only the frozen evidence and allowed/forbidden claim lists. Resolve any model disagreement conservatively: supported only when directly evidenced, rejected when forbidden, and otherwise not established.
